title: Devices
summary: See which Kollab computers are connected and manage their names and trust.

workflows.label: Find a connected computer
workflows.summary: Open the network roster, then select a device to inspect its agents.

entry.prerequisite: At least one computer must be connected to your Kollab network.

steps.action: Find your network in the sidebar, then expand the computer you want to use.
steps.expect: In the example, studio-laptop is a computer in Studio.

steps.action: Open its workspace group and select an available agent.
steps.expect: The chat opens on the agent’s computer.

steps.action: Use /connect status, or Settings → Network → Overview, to check connection and availability.

commands.description: List devices and agents on this computer's network.
commands.expect: Each online computer and its reachable agents are listed.

media.alt: Kollab sidebar grouping Koordinator on studio-mac and Lapis on studio-laptop under Studio
media.caption: Expand a computer under its network to reach the agents it hosts.

workflows.success: You can distinguish online devices from unavailable ones and see which agents are reachable on each.

recovery.symptom: A computer is offline or missing
recovery.action: Start Kollab on that computer, then refresh Connect status; verify both computers joined the intended network.

recovery.symptom: You cannot change network state in this window
recovery.action: Use the Kollab window that owns the network daemon; another window may be read-only.

workflows.note: Only the device running a given agent can start or stop that agent. Network trust rules determine who can message it.

workflows.label: Rename your computer
workflows.summary: Give this device a recognizable name on its network.

entry.prerequisite: Open Connect on the computer whose device name you want to change.

steps.action: On the computer being renamed, choose its device name in Connect and enter a clear name, or run /connect name <name>.
Check Connect status to confirm the updated name is shown.

commands.description: Set this computer's name on the agent network.
commands.expect: The new name appears in the device roster.

workflows.success: The network roster shows the new device name.

recovery.symptom: The name is rejected or still looks wrong
recovery.action: Use /connect help to check the current naming rules, then retry with a short, distinct name.
